source_text: Nos Moysen prophetam recipimus; figuras futuras conscripsit. Qui litteram solam tenet, prophetam non agnoscit.
pass_a_gloss: We Moses prophet receive; figures future he-wrote. Who letter alone holds, prophet not recognizes.
pass_b_english: We receive Moses as prophet; he wrote future figures. Who holds the letter alone does not know the prophet.
